title: Sluiceway deployment record payload
description: The payload of a GitHub deployment record whose task is sluiceway:<stack id>. It holds no property value, no secret and none of the tool's own words.

v.description: The version of the payload. A reader checks it first.

hash.description: The diff hash the tick approved: the first 16 hex characters of a SHA-256. The deploy goes out only when a fresh preview gives the same hash.

ticker.description: The login of the person whose tick started the deploy, plain, without @. On a deploy on merge, whoever merged.

run.description: The id of the workflow run that deploys. The record is open as long as that run is.

attempt.description: The attempt of that run which created the record. Absent on older records.

behind.description: A queued record: the stack ids it waits behind, which have to go out first. Absent otherwise.

drift.description: The hash covers drift, and the deploy puts it back. Absent otherwise.

onMerge.description: The record was opened after the scan of a merge, for a stack set to deploy on merge. Absent otherwise.

anyOf.description: The record of a tick, a queued stack, a drift repair or a deploy on merge.

merge.description: The pull request a tick merged. The record carries no hash, never deploys, and ends when the scan after the merge opens the record that does.

anyOf.description: The record of a tick that merged a pull request.
